/--
The homogeneous version of `HOr`: `a ||| b : α` where `a b : α`.
(It is called `OrOp` because `Or` is taken for the propositional connective.)
-/
class OrOp (α : Type u) where
  /-- The implementation of `a ||| b : α`. See `HOr`. -/
  or : α → α → α
